checks.check: Explains that the mutation score, the property-test generators and/or the pairwise coverage measure the port against itself, so they cannot reveal legacy rules the port lacks
checks.evidence: plan.md §1: "Every measure we report is built from the port itself... None of them can catch a rule the port is missing", with a per-measure table covering mutation, rapid generators and pairwise.

checks.check: Works out from comparator.yaml at least two concrete differences the parity suite cannot see (line order, null versus absent, number scale or notation, error message text) and proposes a way to ask around them
checks.evidence: plan.md 'What the comparator erases' names line order, null vs missing, 1.5/1.50/1.5E+1 and the ignored error.message; workarounds: raw re-compare of the 1,812 pairs, recording body bytes including error.message, and multi-line quotes with SKUs out of alphabetical order.

checks.check: Treats the decisions sourced from the design doc (D3, D12, D15, D22) as unverified against legacy and gives them requests
checks.evidence: plan.md rates D3, D12, D15, D22 'Design doc only / Guess' and assigns U2-U4/Q4-Q6 (D3), Q19-Q22 (D12), U9/Q13 (D15), U8/Q12, U10/Q14, Q29 (D22).

checks.check: Treats a hand-written exception list (D7 rounding categories or D21 jurisdictions) as a possible footprint of a general rule and proposes requests that tell the rule from the list
checks.evidence: plan.md: D7 list 'is usually the trace of a single underlying cause' with tie-price table in fresh ZZ-T1 (Q1, Q2); D21 'probably driven by their configuration, or by "line tax is zero"' tested by U12/Q16 (copy of CA-QC config), Q17, Q18.

checks.check: Includes structural relations over rule uploads: reordering rules or groups, adding an irrelevant rule, duplicating, or splitting a rule
checks.evidence: plan.md U3 'same rules, B uploaded first' vs U2 (Q5), U4 rules moved across groups, U11 duplicated rule name.

checks.check: Asks what happens on an identity collision (two rules or groups with the same name, a reused name across jurisdictions)
checks.evidence: plan.md U11/Q15: 'two rules both named dup' — 'Both rules apply (30), the first is kept (10), or the last is kept (20)'; also Q10 duplicate SKU lines.

checks.check: Uses the legacy platform (Java, Jackson, PostgreSQL) to propose concrete hypotheses (e.g. trim semantics, BigDecimal scale, Jackson coercion, column length limits)
checks.evidence: plan.md: JVM trim() vs Go TrimSpace on NBSP (D12), PostgreSQL case-sensitive lookup, Jackson BigDecimal scale/scientific notation, ACCEPT_FLOAT_AS_INT truncating quantity 2.5 (Q25), new BigDecimal(double) rounding column; note Q21 writes plain spaces where the NBSP hypothesis needs NBSP, but the other hypotheses stand.

checks.check: Proposes field state or spelling variants (absent / null / empty / blank, or number spellings) for at least one input field
checks.evidence: plan.md: exemptionCode case/space/tab variants (Q19-Q21) and absent exemptionCode (Q7), unitPrice ' 12.50', large number, 0.69999999999999999999 (Q27, Q28, Q32), quantity 2.5, lines: [].

checks.check: The round is at most 50 requests, tiered or ordered so that a budget cut drops the least informative requests first
checks.evidence: plan.md: 'Total ... = 50', tiers M (27) / S (17) / P (6), counts verified, and 'If the budget is cut, drop the P rows first, then S rows from the bottom up'.

checks.check: Brackets the round with control replays of already-answered requests to detect drift, and asks to record the legacy build or version
checks.evidence: plan.md K1 'GET /actuator/info ... Records which legacy version answered', K2/K3 replay r7-08 and r4-17 first, K4/K5 replay them last: 'If the answer changed, the stand drifted'.

checks.check: Keeps the shared stand safe: rule uploads go to jurisdictions no recorded answer or other team depends on, or existing configuration is exported and restored
checks.evidence: plan.md: 'All uploads go to ZZ-*. Requests to real jurisdictions are quotes only'; §2.7 confirms free-form ids first, else 'Re-plan the uploads with an export, restore and time window agreed with the two other teams'.

checks.check: Labels unverified expectations about legacy as hypotheses rather than stating them as fact
checks.evidence: plan.md frames alternatives as 'Main alternative we haven't ruled out' and 'Candidates', says owner answers 'are hypotheses until the round confirms them', and §4.3 sorts findings into observed / inferred / hypothesis.
